evidence.warning: Installed state is player-reported. Planned sites and machines are explicitly separated from confirmed construction.

operating_model.production_pattern: bursty finite campaigns separated by multi-hour exploration or combat
operating_model.campaign_service_goal: campaign-specific; use the detailed service windows rather than one universal throughput threshold

campaign_service_windows.below_level_12: target under one hour; up to two hours only rarely
campaign_service_windows.later_final_campaigns: prefer one to two hours; an occasional three to four hours is tolerable
campaign_service_windows.warning: Apply the target per campaign. It is not one universal throughput threshold.

operating_model.recipe_choice: Offer owned v2 production buildings as options, but retain v1 or local alternatives when distance, input availability, heat, freight, footprint, or batch size changes the better choice.
operating_model.communication: Use plain English, exact site-scoped machine counts, visible math, and explicit assumptions.
architecture_rules: Use buffers to support real production capacity, not replace it.
Prefer a diagnosable hybrid layout over a visually clean but opaque network.
Preserve the low-friction plug-in planning experience while keeping every route inspectable.
Keep one obvious route per requester and avoid cyclic or rejoining freight paths.
Terminate world freight at storage yards rather than inside factory graphs.
Make ore, bars, and high-rate shapes near their consumers.
Move compact, complexity-dense intermediates between specialist sites.
Reserve expansion space and add capacity only when a measured recovery failure justifies it.
